text:
Maria: quick sync request — we need to stitch the scope lanes for the ACME pilot. main risks: runtime KV change, infra prewarm, security checklist, and customer e2e. can we align ownership + gating criteria?
Jun: I can own the runtime change but it's a small KV layout tweak that impacts cache priming. estimate 3 dev days + 1 day integration. will need a test vector from ACME.
Alex: infra needs a prewarm playbook for burst on dedicated pools. rough plan: warm N GPUs 10m before traffic, fallback to shared if warm fails. need autoscale knobs from PM.
Sara: security review: we need threat model signoff + HSM access audit. security review slot earliest Thu. if launch before that, must be documented mitigations.
Rahul: ACME is ok to provide test dataset but needs residency proof. also they want a smoke window for customer acceptance testing (2 hours).
Maria: thanks. preliminary gating I propose: 1) runtime unit + integration tests green, 2) infra prewarm runbook tested on staging, 3) security mitigations logged and review scheduled, 4) ACME smoke window scheduled + success criteria. sound reasonable?
Jun: +1 for that flow. small note — runtime test depends on a KV-preserve flag we add in config. i can PR tomorrow.
Alex: can you drop the config snippet? ops needs specific values.
Jun: sure, put this in staging config:
```
autoscale:
  prewarm: true
  prewarm_lead_minutes: 10
  fallback_pool: shared-gpu
  max_burst_nodes: 4
```
Alex: perfect. infra will validate those limits on staging tom. also adding healthcheck endpoint for prewarm: `/internal/prewarm/status`.
Sara: flagged: HSM access requires JIRA INFSEC-421. please attach runbook. we can do a weekday expedited review if runbook is complete.
Maria: ownership summary: Jun -> runtime changes + tests; Alex -> prewarm runbook + infra test; Sara -> security signoff + JIRA; Rahul -> ACME test data + A/C criteria; Maria -> overall launch criteria + coordination.
Rahul: i'll confirm ACME availability for the smoke window Thu 15:00-17:00 PST. will post confirmation by EOD.
OpsBot: Suggested meeting: 30m sync Thu 10:30 PST — calendar invite created -> #product. (use /invite to add others)
Maria: Thu 10:30 works for me. please bring staging logs if infra test runs fail. we'll gate on those. :thumbsup:
Jun: i'll have the PR + test vectors ready.
Alex: infra run scheduled Wed night on staging. will paste results in this thread.
Sara: will queue review for Thu morning.
Maria: thanks all — if anything slips, call out blockers here. closing with action items in the calendar invite. :white_check_mark:
